label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The page ends with hundreds of empty status elements and the promo images carry very long descriptive alt text, so the page is slow and noisy to listen to.
After pressing Enter on the Dresses link nothing was announced and the page title stayed the same; I had to re-read twice to find out that the category page had loaded.

After choosing a size, a second duplicate Add to bag button and a second price and rating block appeared, so two identical buttons with the same name exist and I could not tell which was the real one.

Adding to the bag gave no clear confirmation; only a tooltip appeared that first showed Subtotal 0.00 euro, then vanished on its own, so the Proceed to checkout button was no longer found and I had to reopen the cart by focusing the cart button.

After activating Proceed to checkout the old page stayed for a moment, then a blank checkout page with an empty main area appeared with no loading message, so I had to re-read twice before the form showed up.
